summary: The light, rising soul, the one a summons can call back. It is paired with 魄.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Newton–Leipnik trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 魂 takes the highest of the eight points and 魄 the lowest, after the Liji’s 魂氣歸于天，形魄歸于地. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: Soul, Come Back
satellites.evidence: In the Summons of the Soul the shaman Wuyang is told 魂魄離散, the souls are scattered, and calls: 魂兮歸來！去君之恒幹，何為四方些 — “soul, come back! Why leave your constant frame for the four directions?” Each direction is then shown as a place of horrors where no soul can stay.
satellites.caveat: Attributed to Song Yu or to Qu Yuan; the attribution is disputed.
